mentions.name: OneBusAway Cloud
mentions.description: A hosted platform for deploying and running public transit services, pitched as 'Heroku for public transit'. A project of the non-profit Open Transit Software Foundation whose revenue funds other initiatives, such as bringing real-time transit information to billions of people worldwide. Recent work includes product polish, support for deploying an SMS and phone gateway to real-time transit information, and marketing solutions pages for higher education, SMS, and more.
mentions.audience: Public transit providers, including higher education institutions reached via its solutions pages
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m still building OneBusAway Cloud, which you can think of as being Heroku for public transit.
